name: prisant-powertools
description: General-purpose agent skills for the work around the work: session continuity, structured analysis, guide authoring, cross-LLM peer review, repository auditing, resolving open questions and decisions, status snapshots, weekly usage audits and a cross-repository pulse, shipping finished branches, keeping an organization's profile README current, and the specification and release-planning documents that sit between an idea and a tag. Use when wrapping or resuming a coding session, turning raw thinking into a decision-ready brief, generating a guide bundle, getting a second-model review of a document, auditing a repository, walking through the questions and decisions a session left open, writing a status snapshot of a repository, auditing a week of one's own Claude Code usage, rolling every repository up into one weekly pulse, documenting and merging finished branches, writing a feature spec, managing a version-scoped release plan, or scaffolding agent infrastructure into a repository.

interface.shortDescription: Agent skills for the work around the work
interface.longDescription: Fifteen skills for the work around coding: closing and resuming sessions, decision briefs, guide bundles, second-model reviews, repository audits, specs and release plans, status snapshots, usage audits, a weekly project pulse, and shipping finished branches. Eight of them run only when you call them by name.
defaultPrompt: Wrap up this session and write the session log.
Walk me through the pending questions and decisions.
